title: Record the controlled block reversal
body:
## Summary
- Reversing each aligned block of length `2^width`, on the blocks whose start has a chosen bit set, equals XORing those low bits where the same bit is set.
- Through dimension 16 this holds for all 680 pairs whose control bit is at least the block width, and it fails for all 680 pairs whose control bit varies inside a block.
- Partial result, no new kappa. The selected frontier is unchanged.
